title: Real Line Congruences of Trilinear Birational Maps
summary: Trilinear mappings appear naturally when performing spatial isogeometric discretizations of degree $p = 1$. Among them, birational maps are characterized by the property that both the mapping and the associated inverse map are rational and thus easy to evaluate. These mappings have recently been analyzed, and a classification over the field of complex numbers has been obtained.
